annotations.title: UAE GPSSA pension contribution for an Emirati employee

description: Monthly GPSSA pension contributions for a UAE national in the private sector (all emirates except Abu Dhabi). 2023 law (first registered on or after 31 Oct 2023): employee 11%, employer 15%, of which the government pays 2.5 points when the contribution salary is under AED 20,000. 1999 law (registered earlier): employee 5%, employer 12.5%, government 2.5%. Contribution salary AED 3,000 to 70,000 a month. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/gpssa-contribution-calculator/
